snapshot.description: Aluminum Raspberry Pi 5 case with M.2 NVMe SSD slot via PCIe for maximum storage performance.
features: U-shaped PCIe connector for M.2 board
Aluminum THRML heatsinks with blue thermal pads included
Programmable safe shutdown via power button
U-shaped PCIe connector with locking tabs
Silicon thermal pads for CPU, RP1, PMIC, RAM, and NVMe
FE1.1S USB Hub Chip for front USB 2.0 ports
Black NVMe supplemental power cable included
